text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day.
A day when everyone's heart flutters with excitement—

They say that not only friends, but also Umamusume
and Trainers sometimes exchange gifts as a token of friendship. However...

My trainee Gold Ship is completely off the charts.
It's best not to expect anything ordinary from her.

For now, I have prepared
the chocolate to give in return.

If I hand this over after training,
it should wrap up the day pretty neatly.
Or so I had thought...
Forget training time—even with evening approaching, Gold Ship is nowhere to be seen.

Growing worried,
I was just about to make a phone call, when—
(Bzzzt, bzzzt)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Peace-peace☆ Golshi-chan here☆
Didn't see ya at all today, you still alive?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa... You're a lot more eager than I expected.
My bad, my bad, had some trivial business to take care of."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "—Honestly, I'm actually at the beach right now."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"It's the sea, yeah, the sea.
Gold Ship In The Sea."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Well, it took a bit of effort to catch this red sea bream, you see~"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, I'm almost done wrapping things up here,
so wait for me over there, got it? Later!"
(Beep, beep...)

My mind can't keep up with this unexpected turn of events...
All I can do is wait for their return as told.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look at you latching onto that like a dog when its owner comes home.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My bad for makin' you worry. But hey,
I brought back something that was totally worth it!
(BOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Order up!! One red sea bream, comin' right up!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, it's Valentine's Day today after all.
It's a token of my appreciation. Thanks for everything as always, Trainer!
(Flap, flop-flop!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...That's the part you're latching onto?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It was way tougher than I expected,
so I brought it along without finishing it off.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Come on, you take responsibilityand clean this up nicely! Got it?!
Afterward, we took the red sea bream to the cafeteria and had a professional chef prepare it for us.
The red sea bream prepared as sashimi was... utterly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, I caught it safe and sound, so we're all set.
So hurry up and get over here too!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "I'll be waiting by the coast. See ya!"
(Beep, beep...)

I don't quite understand what's going on,
but it seems like we have no choice but to head to the sea...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, over here, over here!
Been waiting for ya!
choice_data_list: Why in a place like this...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah? Don't tell me you don't know?
It's Valentine's Day today."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And with that... BAM!!

Something was thrust into my hands,
so I hurriedly caught it, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Red sea bream sashimi.
That plump, firm texture is the best!

Faced with such an utterly unexpected gift,
I couldn't help but look up at the heavens...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm stuffed.
That red sea bream was delicious.

It was a Valentine's Day beyond all expectations,
but the red sea bream sashimi was delicious...

Besides, I want to express my gratitude for his sincerity
in going out of his way to catch and prepare the red sea bream.
choice_data_list: Here, this is for you in return.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What, you prepared something too?
You're pretty dutiful, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still though, to think we both prepared
presents for each other, huh.
Guess going with the red sea bream was the right call after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you're actually asking that?
Trying to peek into Golshi-chan's true feelings, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Y'know, fish have their own language, just like the language of flowers."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So, as for the sea bream's fish language—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Nah, never mind. I quit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me of something Maruzen said:
"A fine woman always has her secrets."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm leavin' this up to your own discretion!
Look into it yourself if you're so curious! Later!
Though dragged around by Gold Ship's wild antics, I felt like... it was a fun day after all.
